name: Glovis America Vehicle Processing Center - Tacoma WA (Hyundai)

fieldNotes.facility: Port of Tacoma vehicle processing center operated by Glovis America / WWS for Hyundai-Kia auto imports. Confirmed via Glovis locations page + NWSA press release naming 3400 Taylor Way, Tacoma. Massive finished-vehicle marshalling yard, not a freight warehouse.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Double-leaf chain-link swing gate across the gravel driveway entering the NW corner of the vehicle yard, confirmed in two Street View headings (2024-04). Rail crossing immediately in front of the gate on the access road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white booth / kiosk structure visible just inside the gate, left of the lane, in Street View. Footprint is small; possible it functions as remote check-in rather than a continuously staffed shack -- flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: NONE -- this is a vehicle processing center; vehicles drive on/off car-carriers and ships. The on-site PDI/processing building has roll-up service doors but no freight loading docks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ -- the yard is overwhelmingly finished-vehicle storage (thousands of cars in marked rows); also stages car-carrier trailers. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved staging/queue area with KEEP CLEAR markings just inside the gate where car-carriers and processing trucks stage.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run alongside the access road and into the property -- inbound vehicles arrive by both rail and RoRo ship.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate expressed as vehicle-storage capacity (~8,000 cars across the marshalling rows); not trailer stalls. Low confidence on exact figure.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~110 acres derived from the perimeter box covering the core marshalling yard; the broader Glovis/WWS port footprint is larger.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gravel apron at the gate and broad internal roadways leave ample room to add a bypass / express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban -- inside the Port of Tacoma industrial tideflats, dense industrial fabric of the Tacoma metro.
